title: Born in 1912 at his grandfather's house, a string player
summary: Born October 1, 1912 at Danty and Oak in New Orleans, his grandfather's house; the grandfather played guitar, banjo, bass and violin and taught him to tune.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You might start when you were born, give your birth date if you don't mind.
I was born October 1st, 1912. Right here in New Orleans, yeah.
Do you remember the neighborhood exactly about where you were?
Yeah, on Danty and Oak, and the house is still there. It's my grandfather's residence.
Yeah, in the old Cowan section, yeah. Two blocks off of Cowan Avenue, right on the corner of Oak and Danty.
You mentioned a minute ago your grandfather played music?
Oh yeah, he was accomplished on just about all the string instruments. Played the guitar, banjo, bass, and his specialty was violin.
And he was the one that taught me how to tune this instrument and helped me to learn some of the basic things about it.
